derivation:
apply PresentedGroup.ext
  rintro ⟨p, a⟩; rw [hφ, lift_generator]
explanation: `PresentedGroup.ext` states that homomorphisms out of any presented group are equal when they agree on every generator. Here the generators are `PresentedGroup.of (p, a)`, definitionally `generator p a`; the target proof uses this Mathlib result indirectly through `Steinberg.hom_ext`.
